_note: Captured 2026-07-29 from REAL signed-in DOM, through the app's own WKWebViews (the only
signed-in surface on this device — Simulator Safari is signed out of all four platforms).
Provenance distinguishes two strengths of claim, and the distinction is load-bearing. 'resolved'
means an element matched. 'DRIVEN' means the pipeline acted on it and the outcome was asserted —
which is the only claim that rules out the P1 failure, where every click resolves and lands and
the harvest returns nothing. ChatGPT's composer and send are DRIVEN; the rest are resolved.
Measured while driving ChatGPT's send (settles the isTrusted question): every dispatched event
reported isTrusted === false, and the message sent regardless — composer cleared, user turn 0->1,
assistant replied in under 8s. So this control does not gate on trust and the app can drive it
with evaluateJavaScript. HID taps remain the fallback for a control that does gate.
The 14 absent keys are absent on purpose. Eight need a response on screen (sources,
response_container, activity_panel, artifact_panel, audio_ready_marker); five need an interaction
first (ChatGPT's send appears only once the composer is non-empty, and its research option lives
inside the composer-plus menu; NotebookLM's add_source and generate_audio live inside a notebook,
not on the notebook list); and Gemini's deep_research_toggle is a contract mismatch rather than a
missing value — see the note in bin/capture_selectors.py.
surface is ios-app-webview, not ios-mobile-safari: the app pins an iPhone Safari 17 user agent
while Simulator Safari reports 26.5, so the two surfaces are not proven to render the same DOM.
